name: wan-ofi-furniture
description: Wan Ofi Furniture — Furniture ERP, e-commerce and production management system (MERN)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
